capabilities: Display a floating collapsible heading outline beside the editor
Expand the outline on hover and navigate to headings by click
Search and filter headings in real time
Configure sidebar position, size, and heading level filtering
Extract heading text via HTML stripping or a custom regex pattern
extras: Documents how custom regex overrides other parsing, and provides CSS variables and classes for snippet-based styling.
intentEvidence: displays a floating, collapsible (Notion-style) outline of your note's headings on the side of the editor
problem: Obsidian's outline requires opening a separate panel, so there is no always-available, unobtrusive way to see and jump between a note's headings while editing.
summary: Floating collapsible heading outline shown beside the editor, with hover expansion, click navigation, filtering, and customizable parsing and placement.
